drawings.name: line_scroll_reader
drawings.prompt: An invented student character (simple round face, dot eyes, short hair, sweater) sits cross-legged on the floor, reading a paper scroll held up in both hands. The scroll is absurdly long: it unrolls from the student's hands down to the floor and runs away in big loose loops and curls that fill the lower half of the picture, ending in a roll. High above the student hangs a big plain round wall clock with a thick rim and a small centre pin, and NO hands at all (an empty clock face, only twelve short tick marks). Portrait image 1024x1536; the clock in the upper third, the student and the looping scroll below; together they fill about 85% of the width and 85% of the height. The scroll paper is blank: no writing, no lines of text, no letters, no numbers anywhere.

drawings.name: line_squeeze_strip
drawings.prompt: An invented character (simple round face, dot eyes, short hair, apron) kneels at a small open wooden box on the floor and, with both hands, pushes a very long paper strip folded like an accordion (concertina) into it. The folds that are already in the box are pressed tightly together; the part of the strip still outside lies in wide loose folds trailing off to the left. The character's face shows effort and concentration. Landscape image 1536x1024; the character, the box and the strip fill about 90% of the width and about 75% of the height. The strip is blank paper: no marks, no text, no letters, no numbers.

drawings.name: line_clockwork
drawings.prompt: An open clockwork seen straight from the front: a row of toothed gears meshed together, sizes growing from left to right, from a tiny gear at the far left through middle-sized gears to one very large gear at the far right. Each gear has spokes and a centre pin. An invented person's hand (only the hand and wrist, coming in from the bottom right) holds a small round brake knob pressed against the rim of the largest gear, slowing it, while the small gears are left alone. A few short motion lines next to the tiny gears show they spin fast. Landscape image 1536x1024; the gears fill about 90% of the width and about 70% of the height, centred. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.

drawings.name: line_scroll_ends
drawings.prompt: An invented student character (simple round face, dot eyes, glasses) sits at the middle of a very long low table on which a paper scroll lies unrolled from the far left edge to the far right edge. The student leans out with a magnifying glass towards the left end of the scroll and points a finger at the right end, eyes on the ends, while the long middle part of the scroll right in front of them is ignored and has a small dust bunny and a sleeping fly on it. Landscape image 1536x1024; the table, scroll and student fill about 92% of the width and about 60% of the height. The scroll is blank paper: no text, no lines, no letters, no numbers.
